description: Change Arx site security: apply or revert hardening measures, run a check, secure all recommended measures, set automatic security updates, update one component (update: item {type core|plugin|theme, slug}), or fix everything that can be fixed (fix_all: missing recommended settings plus updates; premium plugins and issues without a fix are skipped with a reason), update only the components with a fixed vulnerability (update_vulnerable: no settings, no plain outdated updates, premium skipped), restore original WordPress files (restore_files, optional item {type: core} or {type: plugin, slug} to limit it: reinstall core and wordpress.org plugins whose files differ from the release, same version; changed files backed up and put back if the site stops answering; premium skipped; extra files in wp-admin and wp-includes are removed, also backed up), or remove one injected code snippet found in the WordPress database (db_clean: dbFindingId from status dbFindings; the post keeps a revision and the old value is backed up); contain a takeover found by the compromise scan: remove_fake_admins (deletes wp2shell-style fake admin accounts, their content goes to a real admin) or quarantine_backdoor (item {type: plugin, slug}: backs up and removes a backdoor plugin), or quarantine_folder (Lanetti support only: packs one hacked folder under public_html into a private archive and removes it); waf_allow (blockRef from status wafBlocks: adds narrow firewall exceptions for that site, path and the rules that matched, then updates the servers); block_page (blockPage {enabled, message, contact}): the page visitors see when the site's firewall stops a request (on by default; message plain text up to 300 characters; contact an email or https link); freeze_admin (wpUserId: removes the account's roles, signs it out everywhere, random password, deletes app passwords; kept for unfreeze; not the last administrator) and unfreeze_admin (wpUserId from status frozenAdmins: gives the roles back; the owner then sets a new password with Lost your password); quarantine_exposed (path from status summary.exposures: moves a file a visitor could open that leaks data, e.g. a debug script printing site secrets, phpinfo, a public database dump, into the site's private arx-quarantine folder, kept 30 days). Confirm required. Changes are verified and each update is rolled back if the site stops answering. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: apply/revert measures, run a check, secure recommended, set auto updates, update one component (item), fix_all (settings + updates; premium and no-fix items skipped with a reason), update_vulnerable (only components with a fixed vulnerability), restore_files (reinstall changed WordPress core and wordpress.org plugin files, same version, and remove extra files in wp-admin and wp-includes; backed up, rollback on regression), db_clean (remove one injected snippet from the WordPress database: dbFindingId), remove_fake_admins (delete wp2shell-style fake admins found by the compromise scan) or quarantine_backdoor (item {type: plugin, slug}: back up and remove a backdoor plugin), quarantine_folder (Lanetti support only), block_page (blockPage: the page visitors see when the site's firewall stops a request), waf_allow (blockRef: allow a firewall block for this site and path), freeze_admin (wpUserId: lock a WordPress account: no roles, signed out, random password, no app passwords; not the last administrator), unfreeze_admin (wpUserId from frozenAdmins: roles back; owner resets the password), quarantine_exposed (path from summary.exposures: move a leaking public file into the private quarantine folder).

autoPatch.description: auto_patch: security (vulnerable items, snapshot + verify + rollback), minor (also same-major updates), all, or off.

blockPage.description: block_page: enabled (default on), message (plain text, empty clears), contact (email or https link, empty clears).

blockRef.description: waf_allow: ref of a block from oma_arx_security_status wafBlocks.

folder.description: quarantine_folder (Lanetti support only): one folder right under public_html.

item.description: update: the component (core slug is wordpress).

updateExclusions.description: auto_patch: plugin:<slug>, theme:<slug> or core, never updated automatically.

updateWindow.description: auto_patch: update window in Finnish time; null = default (shops 01:00-05:00).

name: oma_arx_security_change
title: Change Arx site security
